articles.title: Ethereum lending app Term Finance loses $8.5 million after attacker buys voting power
articles.snippet: The exploit shows how lightly held voting tokens can become a means of attack when control of a protocol is cheaper than the assets it governs.

articles.title: Term Finance loses estimated $8.5M in vault governance exploit
articles.snippet: Term permanently closed its Meta Vaults after an attack reportedly removed nearly all of their Ethereum deposits.

articles.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
articles.snippet: The Entra ID flaw earned the highest possible severity score, but Microsoft says it patched the bug before publishing the CVE and found no evidence it was ever exploited.

articles.title: Coldcard Adds New Security Measures After $130 Million Bitcoin Exploit
articles.snippet: Coinkite's latest firmware requires users to add their own randomness when generating wallet seeds and fixes additional security issues uncovered during a three-week review.

articles.title: CFTC Chair Readies Crypto Rules If Congress Fails to Pass Clarity Act
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair said staff is already exploring a crypto market structure framework and could move quickly to propose rules if Congress fails to act.
